## Data

Alaska ragional boundaries, community locationsa nd population, and Alaska rivers data will be used, obtained from https://dev.nceas.ucsb.edu/view/urn:uuid:6f07cb25-a4a1-48e8-95cb-74f532f3ce2d

## Analysis

```{r}

library(readr)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)
library(ggspatial)
library(dplyr)

```
